mapper.select: SELECT MSG_ID, MSG_TYPE, MSG_TYPE_SECOND, SUBJECT, SCHEDULE_TIME, SUBMIT_TIME, MESSAGE, CALLBACK_NUM, RCPT_DATA, K_ADFFLAG, K_TMPLCODE, K_MESSAGE, K_SENDERKEY, RESERVED01, RESERVED02, RESERVED03, FAIL_SEND FROM AM2X_SUBMIT WHERE RESERVED01 = 'MSF' AND RESERVED02 = #{reserved02} AND RESERVED03 = #{reserved03} AND RCPT_DATA = #{rcptData} AND SUBMIT_TIME >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') || '000000'
